items.item:
10. After anonymising a project it has no revision: correcting or erasing it
    stating its former revision is refused as stale and changes nothing; a
    project deleted whole is not found.
   Shows A04-4, A04-5. [witness: verification:registry_a04_anonymised_project_former_revision_stale]
statements:
=> r.revision' = r.revision + 1
                             and r.last_changed' = now
  accepted erasure, anonymisation or deletion => r has no revision after   -- A04-4
r has no revision and a.stated_revision present => refused as stale   -- A04-5

verdicts.item:

statements:
=> r.revision' = r.revision + 1
                             and r.last_changed' = now
  accepted erasure, anonymisation or deletion => r has no revision after   -- A04-4
r has no revision and a.stated_revision present => refused as stale   -- A04-5
verdicts.why: The check asserts that anonymisation leaves no revision-bearing fields, former-revision corrections and erasures are stale and change neither reads nor stored rows, and a wholly deleted project is not found. It only checks a revision increment for the preceding archive and never asserts that an accepted erasure, anonymisation, or deletion increments the revision and sets last_changed to now, so it does not establish every named invariant.
